verdict: Yes, as a regional food brand. Bhaskar's Puranpoli Ghar from Thane pitched varieties of puranpoli on Shark Tank India Season 2, but didn't get a deal. Traditional sweets like puranpoli have loyal buyers, especially during festivals.
angle: Maharashtrian puranpoli is a festival favourite. New flavours and longer shelf life widen the market. Shops, online sales and festival orders drive revenue.
